reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Its a scam and they will keep asking u to pay for everything (i paid and didnt get it)
reviews.reply:
Hello, dear Customer,
Thank you for your feedback. We’re truly sorry to hear about your experience. We strive to provide clear details about payments and services, and we take any concerns seriously. If you feel that you haven’t received what you paid for, please reach out to us, and we will investigate the issue further.
Please contact us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and our team will work with you to resolve this matter.
Best regards,
Nebula Support Team

reviews.title: I want a refund
reviews.text: I was tricked into paying and subscription by filling a questionnaire
reviews.reply: Greetings there! Thanks a lot for your time, your feedback is crucial for our team. Payment troubles are the most annoying ones, we totally sorry for the confusion with them. Please tell us more about your problem at http://help.answers-365.com. Our team works 24/7 to help our users, so you can be sure that you will get rapid solution. Best wishes, Nebula team 🔮
